Cost: 400eb (Expensive)
Class: Bow
Range: Shortbow
Pre-installed: Laser Sight, Zenith (effects already included in these stats)

Laser Sight toggles as an Action; while on and held two-handed the bow counts as Excellent Quality, but you take -2 to Stealth (-4 against infrared/nightvision). +1 to the attack check on its first Single Shot in combat (Zenith).

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
